proposed_comments.title: Make theme-listener initialization transactional

confidence.rationale: The constructor starts the first WMI watcher before creating and starting the second, so an exception in later construction or startup can leave an active watcher undisposed; the changed Mouse Without Borders startup path then constructs this listener directly.

proposed_comments.body: ### Make theme-listener initialization transactional`n`n**Severity:** `high``n`n`ThemeListener starts the app-theme WMI watcher before the system-theme watcher has been constructed and started, and an exception in either later step leaves the earlier watcher subscribed because the fields are not assigned until construction completes. Mouse Without Borders now creates this listener during form startup, so a WMI/service failure can both leak an active watcher and abort tray initialization. Create both watchers in locals, attach and start them inside a try block, dispose and detach both on failure, and assign the fields only after the initial theme reads succeed.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The required fix spans ThemeListener construction, event subscription, startup failure handling, and disposal behavior rather than one safe current diff hunk.
proposed_comments.outOfDiffReason: The required fix spans ThemeListener construction, event subscription, startup failure handling, and disposal behavior rather than one safe current diff hunk.

proposed_comments.title: Limit propagation to supported modules and fix tray icon lifetimes

confidence.rationale: The new fan-out writes a general setting into Awake, ZoomIt, PowerDisplay, and Mouse Without Borders even though this PR only adds Mouse Without Borders behavior, while ChangeIcon retains the shared bitmap on the non-adaptive path and performs a registry theme read even when the feature is disabled.

proposed_comments.body: ### Limit propagation to supported modules and fix tray icon lifetimes`n`n**Severity:** `high``n`n`The General toggle currently advertises and writes the new property into Awake, ZoomIt, PowerDisplay, and Mouse Without Borders, including IPC, named-event, and registry side effects that are outside this PR and are not implemented consistently by those modules. Keep the General setting scoped to the main PowerToys tray icon, expose the Mouse Without Borders setting separately, and remove the unsupported fan-out/ZoomIt interop path. In `frmScreen.ChangeIcon`, dispose the temporary bitmap on every path that replaces the default image, avoid calling `GetSystemTheme()` when adaptive icons are disabled, and preserve fail-open startup behavior when WMI monitoring is unavailable.
proposed_comments.out_of_diff_reason: The correction is cross-module and includes Settings propagation, module integration, tray icon lifetime handling, and tests, so no single current RIGHT-side diff anchor can safely express it.

testInstructions: Launch the already-built x64 Debug PowerToys.exe.
Open Settings > General and verify the main PowerToys tray icon setting describes only the main tray icon.
Open Mouse Without Borders settings, enable the theme-adaptive tray icon, and verify the icon changes with Windows light/dark theme.
Disable the setting and verify tray refresh still works when WMI theme monitoring is unavailable; repeat enabling/disabling to exercise listener disposal and bitmap refresh.
